title: Live sample
description: v0.1. The two public "try it live" buttons: a visitor presses a button, Diocle runs ONE fixed bundled synthetic sample through a real Meta model call and verifies the result. The request carries nothing but the name of a sample from a fixed list; no visitor text ever reaches a model, a command line, a path or the sandbox. $defs.request is the body of POST /samples/live, $defs.job is the answer of GET /samples/live/{id}, $defs.status is the `publicImports.samples` object of GET /config. Strings in these shapes are fixed phrases or values the engine computed; provider messages are never echoed.

sampleName.description: addfee: convert the bundled ADDFEE program with Muse Spark and verify it against GnuCOBOL (a normal run). loyalty-waiver-printout: read the bundled printout image with Muse Wonder and check the transcribed COBOL against the original loyalty-waiver sample.

at.description: UTC time the engine saw it, ISO 8601

estimatedCostUsd.description: List-price estimate; null when a model has no known price

printout.description: The result of the printout button (a reduced transcription.schema.json record plus the transcribed text). The verifier decides; a model reading a printout never certifies anything by itself.

source.description: The COBOL the model transcribed, as written

error.description: A fixed phrase, never a provider or program message

maxUsd.description: The hard dollar cap this job ran under

runId.description: addfee only: the normal run record (GET /runs/{runId}) carrying the stages, tokens, cost and certificate; null for the printout

printout.description: loyalty-waiver-printout only, once the intake has finished

usedToday.description: Starts in the last 24 hours, all visitors

visitorLeft.description: Starts left for the caller in the last 24 hours (best effort, by address)

reason.description: Exactly why the button is disabled, null when it is available

enabled.description: False when DIOCLE_PUBLIC_SAMPLES=0, or the public sandbox is not configured

budgetUsd.description: DIOCLE_PUBLIC_SAMPLES_BUDGET: the most both buttons together may spend in 24 hours, drawn from the public daily budget

spentTodayUsd.description: Estimated spend of both buttons in the last 24 hours (null: a model without a price, fails closed)

busy.description: Id of the delivery or live sample that holds the one-at-a-time lock, else null
